page.layout: One column of running text, with a running head above it. Below the text, at the foot, a gathering signature at the left and the catchword at the right.

main_text.p: mè nos ambiens. His tribus illegitimè intemperantiusq; adhibitis, malaq; qualitate vitiatis,magnę ac pernitiosę mortalib. struuntur infidiæ, unde sæpe perit homo funeris ante diem. Quapropter cum horis successiuis, legitimisq; officiis perfunctus meditari cœperim, seu potius efformandum susceperim universæ hygieinæ,hoc est,sanitatis prorogandæ corpus, proplasmaq; effingere uni-versum, ad quod angustius opus aliquādo dedolari possit,ægre tamen ac difficulter omnia pro animi sententia.

page.notes: The first word "mè nos" is uncertain: the grave accent over the e is clear, but the word may be "me nos" split by a line break or a separate form, so "mè nos" is a best reading. "pernitiosę" and "magnę" have a cedilla-like mark on the final vowel that I read as ę; the exact letter is doubtful. "struuntur" is read as printed, with the long s written as s. The word "susceperim" begins with a long s and is read as "susceperim". The catchword "per-" and the signature ")( 3" are at the foot and are not part of the text. The printed hyphen in "u-niversæ" is joined from the line break "v-" / "niuersæ"; the initial letter is read as a vowel u.
